svg.title: 08 · Component Interaction and Communication Architecture
svg.desc: Map of 26 numbered connections between FSP connectors, account lookup, quoting, the ML API adapter, Kafka, central-ledger handlers, settlement, data stores, reporting and monitoring, followed by a table describing each connection.
svg.text: Who talks to whom, over what, in which format and pattern, how it is authenticated today, and what happens on failure
SDK Scheme Adapter v24.7.0 · one per
MOJALOOP HUB · single Docker network mojaloop-net · plain HTTP and Kafka PLAINTEXT inside
transfer-prepare · -fulfil · -get · -position-batch · notification-event · admin-transfer · quotes-* · fx-quotes-* · event-audit (#17: every service publishes audit events)
shared by central-ledger, central-settlement (#25), quoting and the reporting API (#19)
events processor · GraphQL API · BOP UIs
proxy cache for ALS, ML API adapter,
LEGEND · NUMBERS REFER TO THE TABLE BELOW
Async: request → 202, result as PUT callback
Error callback (e.g. 3204, verified); requester times out; GET is safe to repeat
Lookups fail while the single DB instance is down
ALS, quoting, ML API adapter → central-ledger admin
Behaviour when the ledger is unreachable not verified
No dead-letter topic configured; RF 1 → broker loss loses unconsumed messages
Rollback; the quote is not stored
Error callback to the sender; quote expiry
Kafka ↔ ledger handlers (+ admin API → admin-transfer)
Unprocessed transfers expire via the timeout handler (verified)
Prepare / fulfil → Kafka → position batch handler
Reject → ABORTED_REJECTED; expiry releases the reservation (verified)
Callback retry policy not configured here; FSP recovers with GET /transfers/{id}
Audit events lost if the single broker is lost
Finance Portal → reporting API → MySQL, MongoDB
SDK timeout ~30 s; error body statusCode → FSPIOP code (verified)
In-flight state lost if Redis fails
Object store for bulk payloads (bulk unused here)
Target shown as down; no alerting configured
Green = observed at runtime on 2026-11-04 · red = not verified (needs a test or upstream source review before relying on it).
Authentication column describes this repository. For the proposed controls on each connection see 05b.
